meanings.subhanallah: Glory be to Allah: praising His perfection above all imperfections
meanings.alhamdulillah: All praise belongs to Allah: gratitude for every blessing, seen and unseen
meanings.allahuAkbar: Allah is the Greatest: His greatness transcends all of creation
meanings.laIlahaIllallah: There is no god but Allah: the declaration of Tawhid, key to Jannah
meanings.astaghfirullah: I seek forgiveness from Allah. The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness 70–100 times a day
meanings.subhanallahWaBihamdihi: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His: light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, beloved to the Most Merciful
meanings.laHawla: There is no power and no strength except with Allah: a treasure from the treasures of Jannah
meanings.fourBeloved: The four most beloved words to Allah. Whoever says them, sins fall as leaves fall from a dry tree
meanings.ayatulKursi: The Verse of the Throne, the greatest verse in the Quran. Recite after every prayer; nothing prevents entry to Jannah except death
meanings.durudIbrahim: Salutations upon the Prophet ﷺ and his family. Allah sends tenfold blessings upon the one who sends one salutation
